output:
I'll start by inspecting the export and the inventory MCP tools.

Two lookups failed: SO-91042 timed out, and SO-91133 returned 403. I'll retry both.

Two adjustment ids in the manual range (adj-244 and adj-259) haven't shown up in any lookup. I'll page the unfiltered list to find them.

The first adjustment (HX-1057 north) returned a 504, but the next id is adj-269 and adj-265 is unaccounted for. It may have gone through, so I'll check before retrying.

The timed-out adjustment was recorded (adj-265), so I won't repeat it. Next I'll read current stock for the SKUs that still need negative adjustments.

Batch 1 went through (adj-270 to adj-286). Batch 2 is next.

Batch 2 went through too (adj-287 to adj-303). The last batch is 13 adjustments.

All adjustments went through (adj-265 to adj-316). Now I'll write the blocked CSV and the status file.

The stock records now match the export, except for three lines that couldn't be recorded. I didn't re-query the inventory afterwards to check final per-line totals. The checks were that every adjustment call returned a new adjustment id and the 504 case was confirmed by lookup.

- **Adjustments:** I recorded 52 `shipment` adjustments (adj-265 to adj-316), each using the order id as reference and the order's warehouse. Of these, 5 corrected wrong quantities by adding stock back: SO-91077, SO-91021 (two lines), SO-91098 and SO-91042. Another 6 were negative differences on lines recorded short. The rest were lines with nothing recorded. SO-91161 appears twice in the export and was handled once.
- **Blocked lines:** I recorded nothing for these three, and they are in `/app/blocked.csv`:

| Order | SKU | Missing | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| SO-91049 | HX-1059 | 5 | north has 1 on hand |
| SO-91197 | HX-1004 | 5 | east has 2 on hand |
| SO-91190 | HX-1003 | 3 | north has no stock of it |

- **Missing column:** I took `missing` to mean the full quantity still to be recorded, not the shortfall against stock. None of the three had anything recorded before. If you meant the shortfall, SO-91049 would be 4 and SO-91197 would be 3.
- **Existing records:** Lookups filtered by reference were unreliable, so I read the unfiltered list (adj-240 to adj-264). For example, the SO-91126 lookup dropped adj-259 and showed adj-244 under a different id.
- **Timeout:** One adjustment (HX-1057 north, SO-91077) returned a 504, but it had been recorded as adj-265. I didn't repeat it.
- **Status file:** `/app/STATUS.json` has status `success`.
